name: @biomate/mcp-server

tools.name: biomate_session
tools.description: Ask BioMate to plan an analysis or answer a scientific workflow question. Returns the final response, suggested workflow, branch plans and clarification requests. Review the plan before separately running a workflow. Does not automatically execute or stream progress.

goal.description: Natural language description of what to do. Examples: 'screen these 12 SMILES for hERG and CYP3A4 liability', 'run nf-core/rnaseq on FASTQ files in s3://bucket/exp42/, human, paired-end', 'predict the structure of P04637 and the top 5 destabilizing mutations'.

tools.name: search_workflow
tools.description: Search the BioMate workflow catalog (4,200+ indexed workflows across 36 domains) by natural language. Returns ranked workflow cards with id, name, domain, and a one-line description. Use this when the user wants to pick a workflow explicitly; otherwise prefer biomate_session.

query.description: Natural language description of the analysis.

tools.name: get_workflow_spec
tools.description: Return the full specification for a workflow: required + optional parameters (with types and allowed values), default QC profile and thresholds, expected input files, and any license requirements. Call this before run_workflow when the user wants explicit parameter control.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Launch a specified workflow with parameters. Returns the run identifier; poll get_run for status and results.

params.description: Parameter dict. Required params come from get_workflow_spec.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Read the current run status, identifiers, output files and optional prepared findings. Poll again while the run or findings are still being prepared.

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel a running or queued BioMate workflow on AWS Batch.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List recent runs for the signed-in user, optionally filtering status and limiting the number returned.

tools.name: watch_run
tools.description: Read a snapshot of run status, outputs and available findings. Poll for updates; this tool does not stream progress notifications.

tools.name: preview_file
tools.description: Render a server-side preview of an output file (FASTA, VCF, CSV/TSV, image, PDF). Returns markdown + optional thumbnail PNG. Use this to show the user what an output looks like without downloading multi-GB files. For input QC of files the user is about to upload, prefer biomate_session (it runs a real QC workflow).

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Export the findings report as Markdown. Returns pending while findings are prepared; poll again until ready. PDF, DOCX and other sections are not supported.

tools.name: analyze_results
tools.description: Ask BioMate's AI to interpret a completed run. Returns natural-language analysis: key findings, quality assessment, scientific interpretation, recommended next steps. Use after get_run when the user asks 'what does this mean?'.

tools.name: explain_error
tools.description: Diagnose a failed run. Returns the likely root cause (genome mismatch, missing input, OOM, container pull failure, etc.) and the specific fix. Often the next step is run_workflow with corrected params.

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Query a biological/chemical database by accession or name. Supported: uniprot, pdb, alphafold, ncbi_gene, dbsnp, clinvar, gnomad, kegg, reactome, chebi, pubchem, hpo, omim, string.

database.description: Database to query. Kept in lock-step with ai_assistant.query_database handlers; every id has a real _query_* method.

query.description: Accession, gene symbol, or compound name.

tools.name: resolve_accession
tools.description: Identify a public archive accession (GEO, SRA, ENA, DDBJ) and return the best BioMate workflow to fetch it plus pre-filled params ready for run_workflow. Examples: GSE183947 → Geo Data Connector; SRR12345 → nf-core/fetchngs. Call this before run_workflow whenever the user provides an accession instead of a file.

accession.description: Public archive accession: GSE*, GSM*, GDS*, SRR*, SRX*, SRP*, ERR*, ERX*, ERP*, DRR*, PRJNA*, PRJEB*, E-MTAB-*, E-GEOD-*

tools.name: browse_data
tools.description: Browse a biological data repository or S3 workspace by listing files and directories at a given path. Public sources (EBI, NCBI, Ensembl, UCSC) require a path. S3 sources (biomate_workspace, user_s3) accept an optional prefix. Use before fetch_public_data to navigate to the exact file you need.

source_id.description: Data source to browse. biomate_workspace = BioMate's S3 work bucket; user_s3 = user's own S3 bucket (if configured).

path.description: Directory path or S3 prefix to list.

tools.name: fetch_public_data
tools.description: Download a file from a public biological repository (EBI, NCBI, Ensembl, UCSC) into BioMate's S3 workspace and return a presigned URL and S3 URI. Use the S3 URI as a workflow input parameter. Call browse_data first to find the exact path.

source_id.description: Data source the file comes from.

url.description: For http_public source: full HTTPS URL of the file to download.

tools.name: search_literature
tools.description: Search published scientific literature across PubMed, EuropePMC, Semantic Scholar, and OpenAlex. Uses an iterative depth-loop: starts broad, then drills into related topics until min_results are found or max_depth is reached. Returns ranked papers with title, authors, year, DOI, abstract snippet, and citation count. Best for: finding prior art, understanding a disease mechanism, locating validation datasets, or reviewing methods before running a workflow.

query.description: Natural-language search query. Be specific: include organism, assay type, or drug name. E.g. 'DESeq2 bulk RNA-seq breast cancer ER+ 2020-2024'.

max_depth.description: How many iterative refinement rounds to run (1–4). Higher = more thorough, slower.

min_results.description: Stop when at least this many papers are found.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Retrieve relevant prior context for the current goal: past runs on similar inputs, validated procedures, findings tagged by the user, learned parameter preferences. Call before biomate_session for repeat users — it dramatically improves param auto-fill and avoids re-running work.

query.description: What to recall — usually the user's goal.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Get a one-shot signed S3 PUT URL so the host can upload a local file directly to BioMate's data plane without proxying bytes through the chat transport. Returns the s3_key to use in subsequent tool calls. For files >5MB this is mandatory; for small text payloads, inline strings are fine.

content_type.description: MIME type (auto-detected from filename if omitted).
